articles.title: Crypto custody firm Copper has potential buyers. But offers are way below its $500 million asking price
articles.snippet: Once valued at $2.5 billion, Copper was being marketed by investment bank Cantor Fitzgerald at around $500 million in May this year.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips from $80K as gold cools with falling US bond yields
articles.snippet: Bitcoin bulls battled for control of the $80,000 zone as gold came off its highest levels since mid-May on falling US bond yields.

articles.title: Gemini plans to distribute crypto prediction markets through Apex brokerages
articles.snippet: The proposed deal would make Gemini the exclusive venue for crypto event contracts offered through Apex’s FCM, expanding its prediction-market reach to brokerage clients.

articles.title: Coinbase-affiliated advocacy group endorses candidates for US midterms
articles.snippet: With just over two months until the US general election, Stand With Crypto announced its pick for politicians in its efforts to “elect the most pro-crypto Congress in history.”
